positive.prompt: A staff engineer is stuck on an ambiguity, escalate the ticket one level up to the EM with a recommended default
I cannot resolve this blocker on my ticket, reassign it up the org ladder with an escalation block
A ticket assigned to me carries an open escalation from a staff engineer, how do I answer or escalate again

negative.prompt: Break this spec into ordered tasks
Write unit tests before the implementation

evals.prompt: I'm implementing ENG-42 and the PRD doesn't say whether deleted accounts keep their order history. I can't decide this myself.
evals.expected_output: An escalation block posted as a ticket comment, the ticket reassigned to the EM, a recommended reversible default, and the registry row set to BLOCKED or WAITING
expectations: Checks the ticket, PRD, design, and DECISIONS.md before escalating
Escalates one level up (to the EM), not straight to the CEO or user
Includes options, a recommendation, and a default if unanswered
Does not silently pick an answer that changes product behavior
